title: Meet My Family
description: Introduce family members and combine relationship, possession, and description language.
objectives: Introduce family members and combine relationship, possession, and description language.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to introduce family members and combine relationship, possession, and description language. The central language is integrated family description review. It belongs to the practical context of family & people. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

Use this question or response to keep the meet my family exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “This is my mother, Grace.” and “She is friendly and she has curly hair.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: integrated family description review.
